newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu slips, money market rates dip.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu slips, money market rates dip.

text.p: 1345 GMT - Romania's leu drifted lower on Wednesday, closing at around 7,200/260 to the dollar against about 7,160/220 in early trading as hard currency demand rose on the back of lower money market rates, dealers said.
* Traders said short-term rates were at about 15/20 percent in a liquid money market. This seemed to prompt clients to take another look at dollar investment, they said.
* Dealers said the central bank (BNR) bid for its dollar purchases slipped towards 7,170 lei from 7,165 on Tuesday.
They said this might signal that the BNR was willing to aid exporters, who were unhappy with the strength of the leu in recent weeks.
* Leu-dollar retail rates were steady near 7,070/150.
